name: schedule_api
description: Unified external interface for schedule management, supporting add, delete, update, query, and get all schedule operations. Returns different results based on operation type: add/delete/update return a (bool, str) tuple (success status, message); query/get_all return a list of schedule dictionaries

operation.description: Operation type: add (create schedule), delete (remove schedule), update (modify schedule), query (search schedules), get_all (retrieve all schedules)

time.description: Schedule time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format. Required for add operation; optional for update and query operations

location.description: Schedule location. Required for add operation; optional for update and query operations

event.description: Schedule event description. Required for add operation; optional for update and query operations (used as keyword match in query)

duration.description: Schedule duration (e.g., '2 hours'). Required for add operation; optional for update operation

schedule_id.description: Schedule ID in the format sch_<number> (e.g., sch_1). Required for delete and update operations
